# Quaternius LowPoly RPG Characters (Wizard)

- **Source:** [LowPoly RPG Characters](https://opengameart.org/content/lowpoly-rpg-characters) (Quaternius, Nov 2020)
- **License:** CC0 1.0 (see `LICENSE`)
- **Vendored:** `Wizard.glb` — skinned wizard + staff, idle/walk/cast clips
- **Note:** Original pack ships FBX/OBJ/Blend. This repo vendors a glTF 2.0 / `.glb`
  conversion (textures embedded) for Babylon.js. No paid Source tiers.

Modular Character Outfits – Fantasy [Standard] (itch) was evaluated for Male Wizard
but the free Standard zip only includes Peasant/Ranger outfits (Wizard is Source-tier).
